# Vix

> Vix is a keyboard-friendly terminal text editor (a "Simple Terminal Rust
> IDE") built on ratatui: a thin App shell (package `vix-tui` in `tui/`,
> building the `vix` command) over 146 focused `vix-*` member crates in a
> Cargo workspace (edition 2024), with desktop GUIs in `gui/`.

Development is specification-driven: each crate owns a spec at
`crates/<crate>/spec/index.md`; cross-cutting and app-level specs live under
`spec/`. When behavior and spec disagree, decide which is correct and make
them match. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/AGENTS.md) is the canonical entry point for both
human and AI contributors — read it first. The workspace version is 2.0.0
(unreleased; the latest published release is 1.8.0).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/AGENTS.md): entry point — what Vix is, build/test/lint, hard
  rules, non-negotiable conventions, where things live, the change checklist
- [index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/index.md): user-facing overview — features, install & run,
  configuration, license
- [docs/index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/index.md): the full documentation map
- [docs/getting-started/index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/getting-started/index.md): install,
  first run, the published install channels
- [spec/index/index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/index/index.md): specification overview — goals,
  dependency crates, build/run

## User guides

- [Architecture](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/architecture/index.md): workspace layout (App shell +
  `vix-*` member crates), event flow, rendering, theming, i18n, configuration,
  testing
- [Keybindings](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/keybindings/index.md): every keyboard shortcut and mouse
  gesture, including keymaps
- [Configuration](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/configuration/index.md): settings file, every key, CLI
  flags
- [Keymaps](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/keymaps/index.md): Apple, VSCode, Emacs, Vi, Spacemacs,
  IntelliJ, Eclipse, Sublime Text
- [Menus](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/menus/index.md), [Themes](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/themes/index.md),
  [Internationalization](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/internationalization/index.md)
- [Generated action reference](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/reference/actions.md): every action id,
  its title and menu path, generated from the real catalog
- [Language Server Protocol](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/language-server-protocol/index.md):
  diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion, progress
- [Debugger](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/debugger/index.md): Debug Adapter Protocol — breakpoints,
  stepping, call stack, variables, watches
- [IDE parity features](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/ide-parity/index.md): Local History, Search
  Everywhere, Refactor… and Organize Imports, run configurations, peek
  definition, CodeLens, postfix completion
- [What's new in 2.0](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/whats-new-2-0/index.md): user-facing release notes for
  the unreleased 2.0 — highlights, upgrading, what is not done
- [Launch kit](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/launch/index.md): announcement drafts for 2.0 (never posted)
- [Remote editing](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/remote-editing/index.md): open a folder over SSH
  (experimental) — search, git, language servers, terminal, remote agent
- [Cowork](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/cowork/index.md): real-time co-editing, opt-in `cowork`
  build feature (not in the default build)
- [IM](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/im/index.md): code-aware chat, threads anchored to lines, IRCv3
- [MCP server](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/mcp-server/index.md): `vix --mcp` serves Vix's view of a
  workspace to an AI agent over the Model Context Protocol
- [Large File Viewer](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/large-file-viewer/index.md): read-only viewer for
  multi-gigabyte files
- [OC (containers)](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/oc/index.md): Docker, Podman and nerdctl
- [Database Workbench](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/db/index.md): SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL —
  connections, schema tree, query editor, transactions, history, export
- [Org mode](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/org/index.md): headlines, TODO cycling, table editor,
  Org-roam, export
- [Git Panel](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/git-panel/index.md): status, diff, blame, stage/unstage/
  revert per hunk
- [Scripting](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/scripting/index.md): Rhai `.rhai` scripts — new palette
  commands, key bindings, buffer transforms, no rebuild
- [Performance](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/performance/index.md): measured numbers, with the
  machine and method stated

## Specification (source of truth)

- [CI/CD](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/ci/index.md): GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg pipelines; the local
  parity gate (`scripts/check`)
- [Capability Cargo features](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/cargo-features/index.md): which
  capabilities a build can leave out, and the opt-in `cowork` feature
- [Remote editing](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/remote-editing/index.md),
  [Cowork](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/cowork/index.md), [IM](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/instant-message/index.md),
  [MCP server](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/mcp-server/index.md), [Jupyter](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/jupyter/index.md)
  (spike done, not implemented)
- [Navigation](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/navigation/index.md), [Tools menu](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/tools/index.md),
  [Comparisons](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/comparisons/index.md), [Test strategy](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/test/index.md)
- [agents/share/crate-map.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/agents/share/crate-map.md): every crate, module,
  and file
